messages:
Grace (Docs): Hey team — quick sync on function/tool-calling docs. Found a handful of stale SDK snippets and broken links in the structured-output guide. I'm opening a short PR to consolidate examples and add a migration note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7842. Can people volunteer to review Python/TS snippets?

Ravi (SDK): I can take TS. Which exact files should I look at?

Grace (Docs): Thanks @Ravi. Main ones are `docs/tool-calling.md`, `docs/structured-output.md`, and `examples/ts/func_calling.ts`. Also the JSON schema example still uses the old nullable wrapper for tool outputs — needs updating.

Marta (Eng): I can handle schema cleanup. Quick Q: do we want to keep the legacy `tool_output` envelope or migrate to a compact `output` envelope? Need consensus for migration note.

Noah (PM): Product prefers compact `output` envelope as long as we provide a backward-compatibility migration snippet. Add a short callout in the top of the guide.

Ravi (SDK): Got it. I'll prepare the TS snippet PR and adjust types. I'll also add a short comment about streaming vs non-streaming code paths.

Grace (Docs): Example Python to replace (current):

```python
from sdk import Client
c = Client()
resp = c.call_tool("summarize", {"text": text})
print(resp["tool_output"]["result"]) 
```
Replace with recommended form:

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient()
resp = c.invoke("summarize", input={"text": text})
print(resp["output"]["result"]) 
```

Marta (Eng): On schema: I'll change the example `tool_output: { result: string }` -> `output: { result: string }` and add `additionalProperties: false` to the schema block so parsers fail fast on stray keys. I'll include the JSON Schema snippet in my PR.

Ravi (SDK): For TS, note the runtime method rename: `await client.callTool(...)` -> `await client.invoke(...)`. Also update types: `InvokeResponse` -> `InvokeResult`. I'll include both versions in the snippet (legacy + migration) with a comment header.

docs-bot: PR #7842 opened by @Grace (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7842) — CI: lint ok, link-checker failed (2 dead links).

Grace (Docs): Thanks bot. @Ravi @Marta can you review PR 7842 today? If you can't, please ping tomorrow morning. Also I'll fix the two dead links (one is an absolute path to old examples site).

Ravi (SDK): Reviewing now — left two small comments on the TS snippet (type import path and await placement).

Marta (Eng): Drafted schema PR and linked it in the main PR as a dependency. Also added this note in the migration section: "If your code reads from `tool_output`, replace with `output` and validate the schema with `additionalProperties: false` to catch shape regressions."

Noah (PM): Once merged, let's refresh the docs site and add a redirect for the old tool-output link. I'll open an infra ticket for the redirect and email ops.

Grace (Docs): Great. After merge I'll add a short regression test to the docs CI that renders the example snippets and validates JSON examples against the included schema. Thanks all :rocket: 

Ravi (SDK): ack — will sign off after addressing my comments.

Marta (Eng): ack. ETA EOD.

Grace (Docs): Closing loop: PR 7842 now updated, dead links fixed, schema PR linked (7843). Target merge tomorrow AM. If anything blocks, tag me in the PR. Thanks!
